subtitle: Resurrection life, union with God, and the practice of spiritual authority
editorial_angle: Treat the corpus as a sustained correction: against legalism, rapture-fixation, performance ministry and fear of death, replaced by inheritance already granted and practiced.
target_reader: Local congregations, retreat attendees, pastors and ministers receiving in-person Bible teaching and testimony.

book_concept.purpose: A teaching book that shows believers what they already inherited in Christ — resurrection life, union with the Father, unconditional love and usable spiritual authority — and how to practice it daily.
book_concept.core_subject: A multi-session teaching corpus expounding Hebrews 2, John 17, Colossians 3, Malachi and related texts, joined to personal testimony of healing, resurrection and providence.
book_concept.reader_journey: From inherited habit, tradition and fear of death, through scriptural exposition of destroyed death and granted union, into a disciplined practice of mind, prayer and ministry, ending in testimony and prophetic vision.
book_concept.editorial_progression: Diagnosis of inherited religion → doctrinal foundation (resurrection life, offices, union) → interior anatomy and mental discipline → practice and testimony → corporate vision.

source_theme: A multi-session teaching corpus on the believer's inherited identity in Christ, spanning sacred office, resurrection life, spiritual authority, mind/soul/spirit anatomy, and testimonies of healing, resurrection, and providence, all urging lived practice over ritual, tradition, or fear
source_author_intent: To exposit scripture (Hebrews 2, John 17, Colossians 3, Malachi, etc.) teaching believers they already possess resurrection life, unconditional love, and spiritual authority, correcting legalism, rapture-fixation, and performance-based ministry, while grounding claims in personal testimony
source_audience: Local congregations, retreat attendees, ministers and pastors receiving in-person Bible teaching and testimony
